note: Endpoint recovered from the 개발가이드 page (https://www.index.go.kr/unity/openApi/OpenApiGuide.do), which leaks a dev-env sample URL 'https://localhost:8443/enaraMgmt/unity/openApi/xml_stts.do' — the same path works on the production host. Auth param is idntfcId (not serviceKey). Guide documents format=xml|json|sdmx plus an alternate sttsJsonViewer.do endpoint, but format=json is ignored on the error path (still text/xml), so JSON is an option rather than the default → json_native=1. Error body is a single Korean-named element with a bare message and no machine-parseable code field → error_self_desc=0. No ACAO even with an Origin header; no RateLimit headers. The guide page also exposes what appears to be a live sample key — not used here.

note: Self-hosted V2 gateway on www.safetydata.go.kr (not routed through apis.data.go.kr). Returns HTTP 200 for a rejected key → http_semantics=0. JSON is the native default with no format param needed → json_native=2. Structured custom envelope with resultCode + resultMsg + localized errorMsg, but not RFC7807 → error_self_desc=1. Notably the API response sets eight session cookies (JSESSIONID, latestTouch, sessionExpiry, clientid), which is web-session behavior leaking into an API surface. No ACAO with Origin header; no RateLimit headers.

e-gen (중앙응급의료센터) has no own API host — it delegates to the data.go.kr gateway under agency code B552657, so what is actually measured is the gateway. Correct 403 for an unregistered key → http_semantics=2, the best result in this batch alongside hrdkorea. Default is XML but appending _type=json returns a JSON-encoded error body → json_native=1. CORS confirmed: with Origin: https://example.com the gateway echoes Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://example.com (plus Vary: Origin) — this is invisible without an Origin header, so a naive probe would score CORS as absent. Gateway also sets a full security-header suite (HSTS, X-Frame-Options, nosniff) but no RateLimit headers.

The documented portal page (www.alioplus.go.kr/openapi/openAPI.do) contains no endpoint spec at all — spec and key issuance sit behind login. The live API is on a separate host, opendata.alio.go.kr, discovered via a search hit on opendata.alio.go.kr/facility; /api/v1/facility resolves while /facility 302-redirects and /api/facility/list 404s. Spring Boot backend. HTTP 200 on a gateway auth failure → http_semantics=0. JSON native → 2. Error carries resultCode + Korean resultMsg + English resultMsgEng, custom structured → 1. ACAO echoes the Origin → cors true. No RateLimit headers.

No callable endpoint reachable without authentication. The apiService page lists 7 APIs (전국 구급/구급상황관리/소방대상물/다중이용업소/화재/119 신고접수/구조 현황) and renders Request Header, Required Parameters and Output Results as empty templates — the actual URLs are injected client-side by an AJAX call to /apiService/getApiOutputUrls.do with {type, goods_id}. Both that endpoint and /apiService/getApiOutputUrls return the login-gated HTML shell (not JSON) for GET and POST, with and without X-Requested-With. Probed for a separate API host: api.bigdata-119.kr does not resolve (curl exit, status 000); /api, /openapi/service, /apiService/data, /api/v1/fire all return 404 text/html. Portal documents POST + JSON output generically, but nothing is verifiable without an account, so all indicators are null rather than 0.

Auth param is key (not serviceKey). Returns HTTP 200 with status:"ERROR" in the payload for an unregistered key → http_semantics=0. JSON native default → 2. Richest error envelope in this batch: severity level + symbolic code INVALID_KEY + human text, plus a service echo block with server-side timing — custom structured, not RFC7807 → error_self_desc=1. Re-probed with Origin: https://example.com and no Access-Control-Allow-Origin was returned → cors false, meaning browser-side JS cannot call this directly despite it being a mapping API. Also emits a legacy P3P header and web session cookies (WMONID, JSESSIONID). No RateLimit headers.

The most incoherent status semantics found: an authentication failure is returned as HTTP 201 Created while the body carries resultCode 401. Transport and payload contradict each other, so any client trusting the status line sees success → http_semantics=0. Auth param is capitalised ServiceKey. ResultType=json was requested but the response came back application/xml, so JSON exists per docs but is not honoured on the error path → json_native=1. resultCode + resultMsg is custom structured → 1. No ACAO with Origin; no RateLimit headers, though the guide states a documented 20,000 calls/day cap — that quota is prose-only and never surfaced in headers. Also sets Content-Disposition: inline;filename=f.txt on an API response.

openapi.hrdkorea.or.kr is a catalogue front-end only (returns text/html and states all APIs are hosted on data.go.kr); the qualification APIs live on the data.go.kr gateway under agency code B490007, which is what was measured. Best combined result in this batch: correct 403 plus JSON. Worth flagging against e-gen — both are the same apis.data.go.kr gateway, yet this service defaults to application/json while B552657 defaults to application/xml, so json_native is a per-service registration property, not a gateway property. CORS confirmed by Origin echo. No RateLimit headers despite a documented ~10,000 calls/day developer quota.

CAVEAT — the observed error is service-not-found (ERROR-310), not key-invalid: six candidate Grid_* service IDs all returned ERROR-310, so key validation was never reached and http_semantics=0 is inferred from generic error handling (an error condition returning HTTP 200 with an error body) rather than from the auth path specifically. Treat this indicator as lower-confidence than the other nine and re-test if a valid service ID is obtained. The API key is a path segment, not a query param (/openapi/{key}/{format}/{serviceId}/{start}/{end}), which puts credentials in URLs and access logs. Format is chosen by path segment json|xml with JSON first-class → json_native=2. code + message → 1. Portal host data.mafra.go.kr 307-redirects API-ish paths to its homepage and its docs pages (/caseapp/indexOpenApiIntroduce.do) 404, so no endpoint spec is published without login. Plain HTTP on a bare IP with a non-standard port — no TLS available on this endpoint. No ACAO; no RateLimit headers.

note: KPX runs its own gateway at openapi.kpx.or.kr rather than delegating to data.go.kr, and it is measurably weaker than the data.go.kr路 services: HTTP 200 on a rejected key → 0, and _type=json (the data.go.kr convention) is silently ignored, returning XML either way → json_native=0. Charset declaration is self-contradictory: the HTTP header says ISO-8859-1 while the XML prolog declares UTF-8, which will corrupt any non-ASCII payload for clients that trust the header. resultCode 30 + resultMsg mirrors the data.go.kr envelope shape → error_self_desc=1. Server header is blank. No ACAO with Origin; no RateLimit headers.
